title: Rhythms of Nature
lesson: To understand ‘Rhythms of Nature’, begin with the situation presented in the chapter and identify what is happening. Focus on seasons and cycles and daily and seasonal patterns, then look for evidence for plants and animals responding to change. Finally, explain what you learned and how the idea can guide a decision or observation outside the chapter.
